{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq for each patient
# Do NOT remove rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 — they count as enrolled
df_dedup = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Final count of unique patients
n_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(n_patients)"}
